Guidehouse is a leading management consulting firm dedicated to solving complex challenges for government, commercial, and nonprofit clients. With a strong focus on innovation, integrity, and excellence, Guidehouse delivers strategic solutions across various industries, including healthcare, energy, financial services, and public sector. The company prides itself on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment that encourages professional growth and collaboration. As an organization committed to making a positive impact, Guidehouse leverages cutting-edge technologies and industry best practices to help clients achieve their objectives and drive sustainable success.

About The Role

We are seeking a talented Data Scientist to join our AI & Data team at Guidehouse. In this role, you will be instrumental in helping federal government clients unlock the full potential of their data assets. You will work on a variety of projects that involve data querying, wrangling, engineering, visualization, and predictive analytics. Your expertise will support organizational and mission-driven goals by designing innovative data solutions that facilitate data-driven decision-making, enhance operational efficiency, and improve strategic planning. The ideal candidate will possess a blend of technical proficiency and excellent communication skills, enabling effective collaboration with stakeholders at all levels.

Qualifications

The successful candidate must be able to obtain and maintain a Federal or DoD "Public Trust" clearance. A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related STEM discipline is required. Additionally, candidates should have at least one year of experience in business analytics, data analysis, data engineering, data visualization, or data science. Familiarity with cloud-based analytics environments, such as Databricks, Snowflake, or Impala, is highly desirable. Proficiency in SQL, Python, and R for data transformation and analysis is essential. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and within a team are critical for success in this role.

Responsibilities

Design and develop data visualization dashboards and analytics solutions using Tableau to deliver actionable insights tailored to client needs.
Lead and review data cleaning and transformation scripts utilizing tools such as Databricks, SQL, and Python, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
Maintain, enhance, and troubleshoot dashboards, reports, and analytics tools used in operational and strategic decision-making processes.
Identify opportunities for workflow automation, process optimization, and improved data handling, contributing to implementation efforts.
Collaborate with stakeholders to define use cases, gather requirements, and translate business needs into scalable data science solutions.
Support client engagement activities by presenting findings, demonstrating solutions, and providing technical expertise.
Contribute to business development efforts through responses to RFPs, RFQs, and RFIs, as well as preparing white papers and proposals.
Participate in internal initiatives focused on knowledge sharing, skill development, and staying current with emerging technologies in data science and analytics.

Benefits

Guidehouse offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and professional growth. Our benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage, along with personal and family sick leave, and paid holidays. The position may be eligible for a discretionary variable incentive bonus. We provide parental leave and adoption assistance to support work-life balance. Employees can participate in our 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions. Additional benefits include basic and supplemental life insurance, health savings accounts, flexible spending accounts for dental, vision, and dependent care, short-term and long-term disability coverage, and student loan repayment programs. We also invest in our employees’ development through tuition reimbursement, skills training, certifications, and learning opportunities. Our employee referral program, community engagement activities, and emergency backup childcare further enhance our supportive work environment.

Equal Opportunity

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Position Summary:
Hoffman Construction is seeking a motivated and growth-oriented Data Analyst to join our expanding Data team. This role will be responsible for developing and maintaining a comprehensive database of historical project information across Hoffman's self-perform operations. The Data Analyst will collect, validate, organize, and analyze project data, including unit production rates, labor rates, salaries, project cost of work, and indirect costs, creating a trusted source of truth for estimating, operational performance analysis, and strategic decision-making. Working closely with affiliate companies, operational leaders, estimators, and project teams, this individual will ensure the integrity, accuracy, and completeness of historical data used to support and defend project estimates, benchmark performance, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. The role will leverage traditional and advanced analytics, to uncover trends, improve forecasting capabilities, and support the development of data-driven cost estimates derived from historical project performance. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and skilled in transforming complex construction data into meaningful insights through Power BI, Excel, Smartsheet, and other approved technologies. Reporting to the Data Manager, this position requires strong communication, collaboration, and organizational skills, along with a passion for building scalable data solutions that drive measurable business value. This is an in-person position at the office in Tempe, AZ.

Salary Range: $71,000 - $87,000 DOE

Essential Responsibilities

Partner with self-perform companies to design, build, and maintain a centralized historical project database.
Organize historical self-perform data such as unit rates, labor rates, cost of work, production metrics, and similar.
Analyze historical project performance to improve future cost estimate accuracy.
